headline: ThinkLaw advises Jagsonpal Pharma on acquiring Group Pharma's wellness portfolio

detail: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited (JPL) has acquired the ‘wellness portfolio’ division of Group Pharmaceuticals Limited on a slump sale basis. ThinkLaw advised and assisted JPL in conducting a legal due diligence on the target business, and on the drafting and negotiation of the business transfer agreement and other transaction documents. The Firm provided end-to-end legal counsel to JPL and also assisted in the closing actions pertaining to the transaction. The transaction was led by Ankita Kashyap (Partner), with strategic inputs from Tushar Ajinkya (Founder and Managing Partner), and was supported by Saahil Bijliwala (Associate Partner), Parth Mehta (Senior Associate), Kaushik Krishnan…
